purpose: Project-independent conventions for building plugins by combining SKILLs and custom Agents: naming, launch path selection, defense layers, skill invocation, and waiting for Agent completion.
summary: Naming: use short launch-path names; never use subagent alone; subagent_type only names real agents
Isolated-context work goes into custom Agents; fork-type SKILLs are avoided by default
Launch path selection order: Bash subprocess, general Agent, custom Agent, inheriting SKILL
Inheriting SKILL: do not paste parent context into arguments or prompts
Custom Agent: frontmatter fields, prohibitions in negative form, prompt not treated as parent instruction
Writing Agents need limited targets, no unrelated refactor, syntax validation, allowlist recommended
Multi-layer defense: Agent boundary, role constraint, allowlist, physical deny
Invoke other skills via the Skill tool; never self-invoke
Do not wait for Agent completion with ScheduleWakeup; end the turn and await notification
tasks: Designing a plugin that combines SKILLs and custom Agents
Choosing a launch path for a process
Writing instructions that call another skill
Reviewing SKILL or Agent definitions for compliance
title: Claude Code 作成ガイド（SKILL / カスタム Agent）
